title: Lead Offer Spillovers
authors: Matthew McGranaghan; Jūra Liaukonytė; Geoffrey Fisher; Kenneth C. Wilbur
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Two randomized field experiments on a coupon website (lead-offer value randomized across users) and two lab experiments; cross-sectional comparisons across arms.
design_notes: los_field_exps/los_field_exp_analysis.do: t-tests and reg exp_1_other_prints i.temp_coupon_value (randomized coupon-value arms), subgroup splits by user age; lab experiments analyzed separately. No panel or adoption timing.
data_files_note: Field-experiment data shipped with added noise (proprietary); lab data unaltered.
data_provenance_note: README: field experiment datasets are 'noisy versions of the data where we have added noise to each variable'; lab experiment data unaltered.
software_notes: Stata (plus one R script for profit calculations).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
